verdict.rationale: RevenueCat's Rico feature lets users ask plain-language questions about their data (e.g. 'Why did MRR drop in Germany last week?') and get AI-generated, data-driven answers, directly addressing in-product AI insights; this is documented first-party but lacks independent/hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: independent user reports of Rico's accuracy or usefulness, deeper documentation of suggestion types beyond Q&A.
